mapper.select: SELECT u.USER_NO AS userNo, u.EMP_NO AS empNo, u.USER_ID AS userId, u.USER_PWD AS userPwd, u.LOGIN_FAIL_ATMT_CNT AS loginFailAtmtCnt, u.ACCT_LOCK_YN AS acctLockYn, u.USE_YN AS useYn, e.EMP_STTS_CD AS empSttsCd, e.EMP_NM AS empNm FROM com_user u JOIN hrm_emp_master e ON u.EMP_NO = e.EMP_NO WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT er.ROLE_CD AS roleCd, r.ROLE_LEVEL AS roleLevel FROM com_emp_role er JOIN com_role r ON er.ROLE_CD = r.ROLE_CD WHERE er.EMP_NO = #{empNo} AND r.USE_YN = 'Y' AND (er.EXPIR_DT IS NULL OR er.EXPIR_DT > NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE com_user SET ACCT_LOCK_YN = 'Y', ACCT_LOCK_DT = NOW(), LOGIN_FAIL_ATMT_CNT = 5 WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
UPDATE com_user SET LOGIN_FAIL_ATMT_CNT = 0, LAST_LOGIN_DT = NOW() WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO com_login_history (LOGIN_ID, EMP_NO, LOGIN_RSLT_CD, FAIL_RSN_CD, IP_ADDR, USER_AGT) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{empNo}, #{rsltCd}, #{failRsnCd}, #{ipAddr}, #{userAgent})
